tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and mechanism note support a siphon-driven two-state memory ODE. The trajectory batch is the only offered probe that adds relevant observations and meets the stated minimum of eight rows for fitting its five parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint measurements at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and provide limited leverage to separate memory coupling from its relaxation time.
Neither accounts for the observed sink-gradient and coupled-memory signatures.
It does not add trajectory information that distinguishes the coupled ODE parameters.
